scenes.speaker: Chatty the Parrot
scenes.text: Something strange is happening beyond the mountain bridge! Look at all that smoke. Will you come with me and find out what it is?

options.label: Toward a hidden cave in the cliffs

scenes.prompt: Which way do you think these huge tracks lead?

scenes.speaker: Chatty the Parrot
scenes.text: The tracks end at a cave mouth, glowing faintly orange. Inside, curled tightly around something, is a dragon — and she has noticed you.

branches.text: You remember guessing the tracks led to a hidden cave — and you were right. She is not attacking at all. She is protecting her egg, because something frightened her away from her old home.

You guessed the tracks led toward the volcano, but they curved here instead, to a hidden cave. She is not attacking. She is protecting her egg, because something frightened her away from her old home.
You guessed the tracks followed the river, but they climbed here instead, to a hidden cave. She is not attacking. She is protecting her egg, because something frightened her away from her old home.

scenes.speaker: Chatty the Parrot
scenes.text: Look closely: she is not attacking. She is protecting her egg, because something frightened her away from her old home.

scenes.prompt: Now that you understand why the dragon hid, how do you think she feels? What would help her feel safe again?

stories.description: Smoke has appeared over Ember Mountain. Help Chatty find out what is happening, and who needs your help.
stories.title: The Dragon of Ember Mountain

scenes.speaker: Chatty the Parrot
scenes.text: Pack the brushes! The wind blew the sand off Fossil Ridge last night, and something enormous is sticking out of the cliff.

options.label: A huge plant eater with a very long neck

scenes.prompt: Before we look at the evidence, what is your hunch? Who left these footprints?

scenes.speaker: Chatty the Parrot
scenes.text: Let’s lay the evidence out: six long curved bones, footprints as wide as a wheel, round with short blunt toes, and huge gaps between one step and the next.

branches.text: Your hunch matches the evidence exactly. Round feet, blunt toes, and enormous steps all point to a giant plant eater with a long neck, strolling along the ridge.

You guessed a meat eater, and that was a fair guess for prints this big. But a meat eater leaves narrow prints with three sharp toes. These are round with blunt toes, so this was a giant plant eater with a long neck.

You guessed a small, fast runner. A runner leaves small prints close together, and these are as wide as a wheel with huge gaps between them. So this was a giant plant eater with a long neck, taking slow, enormous steps.

scenes.speaker: Chatty the Parrot
scenes.text: Round feet, blunt toes, and enormous steps. This was a giant plant eater with a long neck, strolling along the ridge. A meat eater would have left narrow prints with three sharp toes.

scenes.prompt: Fossil hunters change their minds when the evidence says so. What would you want to dig up next, and what would it tell you?

stories.description: Something enormous is buried at Fossil Ridge. Dig it out, follow the footprints, and work out who left them.
stories.title: Dinosaur Expedition

scenes.speaker: Chatty the Parrot
scenes.text: Every morning Bolt carries crates along the harbor wall. This morning Bolt did not come, and the crates are piling up. Let’s go out to the reef and find out why.

options.label: Carrying crates along the harbor wall
Watering the gardens on the hill

scenes.prompt: Bolt is working again. What job should Bolt take on now?

branches.text: Bolt rolls straight to the harbor wall and lifts the very first crate off the pile. By lunchtime the whole stack is gone, and the harbor is busy again.
Bolt rolls up the hill path with a water tank strapped on top, and works along the rows until every plant has had a drink.
Bolt rolls out to the lighthouse and polishes the great lamp until it throws a clean white beam across the water.

scenes.speaker: Chatty the Parrot
scenes.text: Bolt rolls off the reef and back toward the harbor, wheels turning steadily, ready for a full day of work.

scenes.prompt: The whole harbor noticed when Bolt stopped. Who helps where you live, and what would people miss if they stopped?

stories.description: Bolt, the little harbor robot, has stopped working out on the reef. Find every part and build it back together.
stories.title: Robot Rescue

scenes.speaker: Chatty the Parrot
scenes.text: Here is the garden gate. Listen. No fluttering, no buzzing. Something is missing in here.

scenes.prompt: One flower can go right by the gate, where everyone will see it. Which one?

branches.text: Look! A butterfly lands on your big orange flower by the gate. Then two more. Then more than we can count, all through the garden.
Look! A butterfly lands on your tall purple flower by the gate. Then two more. Then more than we can count, all through the garden.
Look! A butterfly lands on your round yellow flower by the gate. Then two more. Then more than we can count, all through the garden.

scenes.speaker: Chatty the Parrot
scenes.text: Look! One butterfly. Then two. Then more than we can count, drinking from the flowers you planted.

scenes.prompt: What is the very first thing you notice in the garden now?

stories.description: The butterfly garden has gone quiet and empty. Find out why, plant it back to life, and watch who comes home.
stories.title: Save the Butterfly Garden

scenes.speaker: Keeper Quill
scenes.text: I have kept this library for a very long time, and there is one thing in it I have never explained. Come and look behind the last bookshelf.

options.label: A room the Storykeepers left ready
A staircase going down and down
A garden hidden inside the castle

scenes.prompt: The door is ajar and warm light is spilling out. What do you predict is behind it?

branches.text: You predicted a room, and a room it is: small and round, with a window, a desk, and shelves of empty books. The Storykeepers built it for whoever solved the door, so they would have somewhere to write their own stories.

You predicted a staircase going down and down. There is no staircase, but there is something better: a small round room with a window, a desk, and shelves of empty books, left ready for whoever solved the door.

You predicted a hidden garden, and the warm light did look like sunshine. It comes from one round window in a small writing room, with a desk and shelves of empty books, left ready for whoever solved the door.

scenes.speaker: Keeper Quill
scenes.text: It is a small round room with a window, a desk, and shelves of empty books. The Storykeepers built it for whoever solved the door, so they would have somewhere to write their own stories.

scenes.speaker: Keeper Quill
scenes.text: You solved it, so it is yours to use. Write the first story in the first empty book whenever you like. I will keep the door open.

scenes.prompt: Every clue turned out to matter in the end. Which clue helped you most, and what story would you write in the first empty book?

stories.description: Behind the last bookshelf in Storykeeper Castle there is a door with no handle. Find the clues, solve the pattern, and open it.
stories.title: The Castle's Secret Door
